name: resume-site
description: Hand-built résumé site with role tailoring and in-browser PDF generation. No runtime dependencies; dev dependencies are for the test-suite only.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:pdf && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pdf: node pdf-pipeline/extract-resume-json.cjs index.html pdf-pipeline/resume.json && typst compile pdf-pipeline/resume.typ resume.pdf --font-path pdf-pipeline/fonts
